testErrors.region_endpoint_mismatch:
The bucket is in a different region than the Region / Endpoint you entered.

1. Open the bucket in your cloud console
2. Copy its exact region (e.g. ca-central-1)
3. Set Region to that value
4. For Amazon S3, leave Endpoint as https://s3.amazonaws.com (or https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com)
5. Leave “Force path-style URLs” off for AWS

Then run Test again.
testErrors.invalid_access_key: The Access key ID is not recognized. Check that you pasted the full key and that it belongs to this cloud account.
testErrors.invalid_secret: The Secret access key does not match the Access key ID (or this server’s clock is wrong). Re-paste the secret carefully. For Amazon S3, leave Force path-style off.
testErrors.no_such_bucket: No bucket with that name was found for these credentials / endpoint. Check the bucket name and that Region matches where the bucket was created.
testErrors.access_denied: Credentials work, but this key is not allowed to read/write the bucket. Grant at least s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, and s3:DeleteObject on the bucket (or prefix).
testErrors.network: This server could not reach the S3 endpoint. Check the Endpoint URL, DNS, firewall, and that the instance can access the internet (or your private MinIO host).
testErrors.tls: TLS/SSL failed when connecting. Use an https:// Endpoint and a valid certificate (self-signed MinIO often needs extra setup).
testErrors.unknown: The S3 test failed. Double-check bucket name, region, endpoint, and access keys, then try again.

appSettings.title: App Settings
appSettings.userInterfaceSettingsDescription: Configure application-wide behavior settings. These settings apply as defaults for all users, but users can override them in their personal preferences.
appSettings.defaultApplicationLanguageDescription:
Set the default language for system-generated content. This affects:
• Email notifications (invitations, task updates, password resets)
• Default column names for new boards (e.g., "To Do", "In Progress")
• Reports (when user language preference is not set)

Note: User interface language and activity feed messages are controlled by individual user preferences, not this setting.
